headword: {経済政策|けいざいせいさく}

definitions.explanation: Government measures and strategies aimed at managing or influencing the economy, including fiscal, monetary, trade, and industrial policies.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}の{経済政策|けいざいせいさく}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The government's economic policy was announced.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{経済政策|けいざいせいさく}に{対|たい}して{賛否|さんぴ}{両論|りょうろん}がある。
examples.english: There are pros and cons regarding the new economic policy.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}では{各党|かくとう}の{経済政策|けいざいせいさく}が{最|もっと}も{重要|じゅうよう}な{争点|そうてん}の{一|ひと}つになっている。
examples.english: In the election, each party's economic policy has become one of the most important issues.

notes:
A compound of {経済|けいざい} (economy) and {政策|せいさく} (policy). This is a high-frequency term in news, political commentary, and academic discussion. Understanding this compound helps learners parse similar ～{政策|せいさく} compounds.

USAGE:
- Often modified by the entity responsible: {政府|せいふ}の{経済政策|けいざいせいさく}, {日本|にほん}の{経済政策|けいざいせいさく}
- Common verbs: を{打|う}ち{出|だ}す (to put forward), を{実施|じっし}する (to implement), を{批判|ひはん}する (to criticize)
- Appears constantly in news coverage, especially during elections

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済政策|けいざいせいさく}を{打|う}ち{出|だ}す: to put forward economic policy
- {経済政策|けいざいせいさく}を{実施|じっし}する: to implement economic policy
- {経済政策|けいざいせいさく}の{転換|てんかん}: shift in economic policy
- {経済政策|けいざいせいさく}{論争|ろんそう}: economic policy debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {財政|ざいせい}{政策|せいさく}: fiscal policy — specifically about government spending and taxation
- {金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}: monetary policy — specifically about money supply and interest rates
- {経済|けいざい}{対策|たいさく}: economic measures/countermeasures — more concrete, often responding to a specific crisis
